title: Potential serious allergic reaction
why: Amoxicillin is a penicillin-class antibiotic. Its prescribing information contraindicates use in patients with a history of serious hypersensitivity reactions to penicillins or other beta-lactam antibiotics. Such reactions can include anaphylaxis.
review: A qualified clinician or pharmacist should review the allergy history and medication before use. Do not treat an unverified allergy label or a non-allergic side effect as confirmed serious hypersensitivity.
source: US FDA/DailyMed, Amoxicillin Prescribing Information, Section 4 (Contraindications) and Section 5.1 (Anaphylactic Reactions): https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=ad804b34-169c-44bf-a469-f1149433d96b
